BiblicalUsage: Acshaph is a Canaanite city whose king joins Jabin's alliance against Joshua, is defeated at the waters of Merom, and is listed among the thirty-one kings Joshua struck. The place is covered in the Biblical Places collection — this study covers only how the name is used.
TheologicalSignificance: A place name carries no doctrine, and I will not invent one. What it records is the conquest's completeness: the kings who gathered against Israel fell one by one, and the land they lost became the inheritance of God's people.
